faqs: What are good romantic birthday wishes for husband in Marathi?

Good romantic birthday wishes for husband in Marathi sound warm, specific, and easy to paste on WhatsApp. Use Devanagari for feeling, and keep one soft English bridge if your chat is mixed. Mention his care, humour, or the safety he gives. Short lines often land better than long speeches. Year lock 2026 can sit naturally in one closing wish.
How do I write hubby birthday wishes in Marathi?
